Working with third party vendors and partners, you set direction, priorities, and standards for execution. Lead the operating cadence with partner site leads, including weekly deployment and repair reviews and scorecards; analyze failure patterns and drive corrective actions with network engineering, suppliers, and the WAN/Core teams when the core network/MMR is involved. Experience standing up network operations at a new site or data hall, from commissioning handoff through first turn-up.
